plan: Given my value is $22, and the maximum possible value for any bidder is $20, I should win the auction regardless of the other bidders' values if I bid slightly above $20. To maximize profit, I want to ensure I win while paying as little as possible. Therefore, I will bid $20.10. This ensures I win against any possible value the other bidders may have, and forces them to pay a price close to their maximum.

Since this is a single round, and my value is $34, I want to bid high enough to win, but not excessively high. Given the possible values range from $0 to $20 for the other bidders, a bid slightly above $20 should be sufficient to win most of the time, while minimizing the payment. I'll bid $20.1 to ensure I win against any bid of $20 or less.

Since this is the only round, and my value is $30, I want to win if my profit will be positive. I will bid slightly above what I expect the other bidders to bid, but below my value. Given the range of values (0-20), a reasonable expectation is that the highest other bid will be below $20. Therefore, I will bid $19.5 to ensure a positive profit if I win.
